intents.text:
The **Collaterals Agent** significantly improved efficiency at Simplilearn by automating the creation of marketing materials for new course launches. 

Key achievements include:
- **Reduced turnaround time:** The process was cut from **7–10 days** (involving two teams of four) to just **1 day**.
- **Award-winning impact:** The project earned the **Best Team Award (Q3)**.
- **Automated workflow:** It utilizes a head agent and two sub-agents to research, draft, and validate content, integrating directly with Google Docs for seamless production.

If you would like to discuss the technical implementation or how he might apply this expertise to your team, please feel free to use the "Share your details" button or email him.
